readme_head: # Next-to-go — an AU racing odds dashboard in one Python file A live dashboard for Australian horse, greyhound and harness racing: the next ten races, time to jump, and the best available win/place price per runner across [14 bookmakers](https://puntersedge.online/coverage-report.json). **Python standard library only — no pip installs, no framework.** Prices come from the [PuntersEdge Odds API](https://puntersedge.online/api?utm_source=github_examples&utm_medium=dashboard_readme). ![screenshot](docs/screenshot.png) ## Run it ``` git clone https://github.com/Propertyscout001/au-racing-odds-dashboard cd au-racing-odds-dashboard python3 dashboard.py ``` Open . With no key it uses the free demo sandbox (3 races, truncated bookmaker lists) so you can see it working immediately. For the full feed, [get a free API key](https://puntersedge.online/api?utm_source=github_examples&utm_medium=dashboard_readme#signup) — 1,500 credits/month, no card — and: ``` PUNTERSEDGE_API_KEY=your_key python3 dashboard.py ``` ## Configuration | env var | default | meaning | |---|---|---| | `PUNTERSEDGE_API_KEY` | *(unset → demo)* | full feed | | `PORT` | `8760` | listen port | | `PE_CACHE_SECONDS` | `600` | how often the server asks the API for fresh prices | | `PE_COUNTRY` | `AU` | country filter on the full feed | The server fetches at most once per `PE_CACHE_SECONDS` **no matter how many browser tabs are open** — viewers share one cached copy. If a fetch fails it keeps showing the last good prices and says so. ## What a refresh costs, honestly One fetch of `/v1/racing/next-to-go` costs **2 credits** (measured 2026-08-30 — your `X-Credits-*` response headers are the live truth). | `PE_CACHE_SECONDS` | credits/day if viewed continuously | fits | |---|---|---| | 3600 (hourly) | ~48 | free tier (1,500/mo), all month | | 600 (default) | ~288 | free tier for regular sessions; ~5 days if left open 24/7 | | 60 (wallboard) | ~2,880 | Standard plan (75,000/mo at A$29) | Racing prices move fastest in the last minutes before the jump; there is no cadence setting here that makes stale data impossible. The page shows the fetch age in the footer so you always know what you're looking at. ## Notes - API docs: [api.puntersedge.online/docs](https://api.puntersedge.online/docs) · more examples: [puntersedge-examples](https://github.com/Propertyscout001/puntersedge-examples) - Odds are data, not advice. Nothing here recommends a bet. - 18+. Gamble responsibly — in Australia: 1800 858 858, [gamblinghelponline.org.au](https://www.gamblinghelponline.org.au). MIT licensed.
